header.name: Jeremy Jerome Chia
header.tagline: Senior Analytics Engineer — Operational Analytics and Data Modeling

summary: Senior Analytics Engineer with 6+ years bridging operations and data across APAC and Europe. Specialises in translating complex business requirements into dbt-driven data models and governance-first analytics infrastructure. Expert in advanced SQL, data quality controls, and cross-functional stakeholder collaboration to deliver clear, actionable insights for decision-makers. Chartered Accountant background drives focus on audit trails, compliance, and data integrity.

experience.title: Senior Analytics Engineer, Shipping Finance
bullets: Own finance-ready shipping cost and revenue data models built in dbt and BigQuery, serving as single source of truth for Finance Ops and Group Reporting; embedded governance controls and auditability into core datasets to meet compliance requirements.
Designed and implemented layered data quality controls (dbt tests, reconciliations, anomaly detection), reducing misstatement risk by 90% on €40m of exposure.
Built risk-based control framework detecting carrier billing discrepancies and recovering €1.6m in overcharges through systematic data validation.
Optimised Spark and BigQuery workloads and storage patterns, cutting pipeline runtimes by 75% and cloud compute costs by 15% while maintaining SLAs.
Translate plain-language business requirements into documented metrics, data models, and KPI definitions, enabling self-serve analysis and smoother change management.
Partner across Finance, Operations, and Business teams to gather requirements, document business logic, and deliver insights that inform inventory, pricing, and cost decisions.

experience.title: Data Analyst, Finance Lead
bullets: Built centralised data transformation layer in dbt and Snowflake, integrating Salesforce, Stripe, Twilio, and backend data to power finance and operational analytics.
